Class SkullEyeState

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state.SkullEyeState
public final class SkullEyeState extends Object
Eye state of a placed mob head and of a head item. A head carries the same EyeState.Snapshot a mob does, in a compound a Mixin adds to the head block entity (SkullEyeState.Holder), saved under "somegoogly:data" in its data and replaced on every load, so the server's save and the clients' update packets carry it. A head item carries it as the ModContent.HEAD_EYES component, which the block entity takes and gives as an implicit component, as vanilla's head does its profile: placing the item hands it to the new block entity, and the head's loot copies it back onto the dropped item.

A head type borrows its mob's adult eye definition and shows only the eyes attached to the part of its mob that the head model reproduces (headParts(Identifier, HeadInfo)). Vanilla head types are matched by type, the Heads mod's by block id (entityFor(Identifier)), so that mod is never referenced and its absence changes nothing. A head with no mob here (the dragon, other mods' heads, Heads' heads whose mob's eyes sit on a part the head doesn't reproduce) never has eyes.

Server mutations end in a block update, which resends the block entity's data to every client in range; clients only read the compound.

    • HEADS_MOBS

      public static final Map<String, net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType<?>> HEADS_MOBS
      The Heads mod's heads by floor-block id path: the mob whose definition each borrows. Its wall blocks differ only by a _wall segment. Left out are the heads of mobs with no definition (axolotl, endermite, silverfish) and those whose mob's eyes sit on a part the head model doesn't reproduce (squid, glow squid, slime, magma cube).
